question: Which model achieves the lowest score on the MathVerse benchmark?
model_answer: According to the bar graph, Qwen-2.5-VL-7B achieves the lowest score on the MathVerse benchmark, with a score of 42.3. This is significantly lower than the scores of SRP0-7B (55.8) and GRPO-7B (52.9) on the same benchmark.
